description:
Verify the in-flight migration of app-monitor from app-issue-tracker to swarm-manager is a complete hard cutover with zero legacy/compat/dead code, then finalize it.

## Context

A migration is currently in progress (uncommitted changes touch `scenarios/app-monitor/api/services/app_reports.go`, `api/toolregistry/issue_tools.go`, `api/services/app_diagnostics_aggregator.go`, UI `ReportIssueDialog.tsx`, `useReportExistingIssues.ts`, `useReportIssueState.ts`, `scenarioIssuesStore.ts`, `DiagnosticsTab.tsx`, `LighthouseTab.tsx`, etc.). Completeness and correctness are unverified.

## Scope

1. Inventory every prior app-issue-tracker integration point in app-monitor (API client, tool handlers, UI dialog flows, types, tests, service.json, docs).
2. Confirm each one now routes to swarm-manager (capture / backlog / execution endpoints) with equivalent behavior, including the issue-report flow, the diagnostics → issue creation flow, and any agent-spawn flows.
3. Remove ALL residual references to app-issue-tracker — imports, types, env vars, service.json depends_on entries, fallback branches, dead helpers, comments, test fixtures, docs. No feature flags. No compat shims. No 'legacy mode'.
4. Update tests to assert against swarm-manager only; delete any app-issue-tracker test doubles.
5. Document the resulting migration pattern (mapping table: AIT endpoint → swarm-manager endpoint, AIT type → swarm-manager type) in a short note under app-monitor or swarm-manager docs — this becomes the template for the sweep across other scenarios.

## Acceptance
- `rg -n 'app-issue-tracker|appIssueTracker|app_issue_tracker' scenarios/app-monitor` returns zero matches outside removal-history docs.
- App-monitor service.json no longer depends on app-issue-tracker.
- All app-monitor tests pass without app-issue-tracker running.
- Migration mapping doc exists and is referenced by the sweep item below.
name: app-monitor-issue-tracker-cutover-verify
title: Verify and Finalize App-Monitor's Hard Cutover from App-Issue-Tracker to Swarm-Manager
